UK degree percentages
If a programme requires you to achieve a specific UK percentage, use these ranges to help determine what you need in the qualification you studied.
A first class ranges from 70% to 100%.
A 2:1 ranges from 60% to 69%.
For example, if a programme asks for at least 65%, this would be halfway between the equivalent of a 2:1 and first class in the qualification you studied.
PhD entry
If you’re applying to a PhD or professional doctorate programme, you may also need a masters degree. If you need a masters, this will be specified in the 'Qualifications' section.
English language requirements
You must prove that your English language abilities are at a high enough level to study your degree programme.
English language requirements for postgraduate study
Graduate entry for undergraduate degree programmes
If you are applying for an undergraduate degree programme with graduate entry, the equivalent qualifications for postgraduate study apply. However, the requirements for Veterinary Medicine (Graduate Entry Programme - 4-year programme) BVM&S may be higher.
View programmes with graduate entry on the degree finder for more details on their entry requirements:
Law (Graduate Entry) LLB (Ord)
MBChB Medicine (6-year programme) MBChB
Veterinary Medicine (Graduate Entry Programme - 4-year programme) BVM&S
